card.name: The letter p after a slash
card.fires_on: The letter p (or P) right after a slash, hyphen or open bracket, where a word starting with p comes next. Seen in pairs like prednisone/prednisolone and ILD/pneumonitis.

modes.label: Slash before a p-word
modes.description: A slash or hyphen is followed by a p that begins a second term in an either/or pair.

modes.label: Bare p starting a word
modes.description: A lone p or capital P begins a word such as pneumonitis, patients or pore.

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the text pattern.
card.plain: It fires on the single letter p that starts a word right after a slash or hyphen, as in prednisone/prednisolone.
